entities.summary: Lieutenant-General Sir Aylmer Gould Hunter-Weston, was a British Army officer who served in the First World War on the Western Front, at Gallipoli in 1915, and in the very early stages of the Somme Offensive in 1916. He was also a Scottish Unionist MP.
